dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: CityNet customer service. How can I help you?
dialogue.reading: ˈsɪti ˌnɛt ˈkʌstəmər ˈsɜːrvɪs. ˈhaʊ kən aɪ ˈhɛlp juː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Hi. I was talking to an agent called Linda, but we got cut off.
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ. aɪ wʌz ˈtɔːkɪŋ tu ən ˈeɪdʒənt ˈkɔːld ˈlɪndə, bʌt wiː ˈɡɑːt ˈkʌt ˈɔːf.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I'm sorry about that. Which department does she work in?
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈsɑːri əˈbaʊt ˈðæt. ˈwɪtʃ dɪˈpɑːrtmənt dʌz ʃiː ˈwɜːrk ˈɪn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Customer service, I think. I tried to call her back, but I couldn't get through.
dialogue.reading: ˈkʌstəmər ˈsɜːrvɪs, aɪ ˈθɪŋk. aɪ ˈtraɪd tə ˈkɔːl hɜːr ˈbæk, bʌt aɪ ˈkʊdənt ˈɡɛt ˈθruː.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: No problem. Hold on, please. I'll put you through to her.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ ˈprɑːbləm. ˈhoʊld ˈɑːn, ˈpliːz. aɪl ˈpʊt juː ˈθruː tə hɜːr.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Sorry, her line is busy. Do you mind being on hold for a few minutes?
dialogue.reading: ˈsɑːri, hɜːr ˈlaɪn ɪz ˈbɪzi. duː juː ˈmaɪnd ˈbiːɪŋ ɑːn ˈhoʊld fər ə ˈfjuː ˈmɪnɪts?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's OK. I've been on hold for an hour this week already!
dialogue.reading: ðæts oʊˈkeɪ. aɪv bɪn ɑːn ˈhoʊld fər ən ˈaʊər ðɪs ˈwiːk ɔːlˈrɛdi!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I'm sorry. I can ask her to call you back instead, if you prefer.
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈsɑːri. aɪ kən ˈæsk hɜːr tə ˈkɔːl juː ˈbæk ɪnˈstɛd, ɪf juː prɪˈfɜːr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, please put me through. I don't want to miss her again.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ˈpliːz ˈpʊt miː ˈθruː. aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈwɑːnt tə ˈmɪs hɜːr əˈɡɛn.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: OK. Hold on… You're through now. Go ahead.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ˈhoʊld ˈɑːn… jʊr ˈθruː ˈnaʊ. ˈɡoʊ əˈhɛd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Hi, Nam, it's Linda again. I'm sorry we got cut off!
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ, ˈnɑːm, ɪts ˈlɪndə əˈɡɛn. aɪm ˈsɑːri wiː ˈɡɑːt ˈkʌt ˈɔːf!
